thread:
ashley: Heads up — two eu-west-1 GPU clusters showing ALB target group unhealthy, pods reachable from bastion but ALB health checks 502. Not seeing obvious app errors. :eyes:

sam: Do we have ALB target type=ip for those clusters? If so SGs matter a lot.

ashley: Yes target type is `ip` (we switched last month for pod-targeting). Security group on nodes only allows 443/80 and kubelet ports, but I don't see ephemeral range allowed. ALB healthcheck tries nodePort 30051.

ravi: If ALB->target is IP, health checks come from ALB ENIs to pod IP via node networking. That hits node SG/NACL. Typical culprit: ephemeral port range (30000-32767) blocked.

kelsey: Can you paste `sudo iptables -t nat -L -n` and `aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-xxx`?

ashley: quick snippets: ```
# iptables nat PREROUTING
Chain PREROUTING (policy ACCEPT)
... KUBE-SERVICES ... DNAT tcp dpt:30051 to:10.2.12.7:30051
```

and SG ingress: ```
- 0.0.0.0/0 TCP 80,443
- sg:web-frontend TCP 10250
# no ephemeral range
```

henry: That matches. ALB health coming from ALB ENI IPs (10.0.5.12) -> hits node ENI -> SG denies high ports. ALB sees 502 so targets marked unhealthy.

sam: Quick mitigation options: 1) change target-group to instance mode (avoids pod ports) 2) add ephemeral range to node SG 3) change kube-proxy/service type to `NodePort` + allocate fixed port in allowed range.

ashley: For immediate restore, I'm leaning ephemeral range allowance for the node SG in eu-west-1 edge subnets. Will push a narrow rule limiting source to ALB SG/ENI CIDRs.

ravi: +1. Also add a guard in terraform module so future clusters using ip target type set `node_security_group` ephemeral range. We saw this when we switched to pod-targeting.

kelsey: Can you open a quick PR with the change and tag me? We'll run it during low-traffic window. Also add note to runbook: when ALB target=ip, ensure ephemeral 30k-32767 is allowed from ALB SG.

ashley: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/compare/PR-4521 — adds `allow 30000-32767 from sg:alb-edge` to `modules/k8s/node_security_group`. Plan looks clean.

infra-bot: deploy started for PR-4521 by ashley — plan OK, applying in eu-west-1 (staging first).

henry: After apply, ALB targets flipped healthy within 30s. :white_check_mark: Watching for any regressions.

ashley: Confirmed: clusters back to normal, pods resumed traffic. Adding follow-up tickets: (1) terraform guard for module, (2) alert rule to detect ALB->target 5xx spike tied to SG changes.

kelsey: Nice catch. Documented in runbook and sending a short blurb to #incidents for awareness. :thumbsup:

sam: Heads-up for next time: consider instance target type for GPU-heavy nodes if we want simpler SG surface, but we lose pod-level LB. Tradeoffs.

ashley: Agreed — will add notes to infra design doc. Closing thread soon.

henry: FYI we should also audit other regions for same misconfig. I'll kick off a quick script to list clusters with target-type=ip and node SG missing ephemeral rule.

ravi: Thanks team. Good triage flow.
